Write the log-odds as $\logodds$ (the Greek letter eta), not as $z$ or another letter.
In a group that uses shared macros (see [Using shared macros](#using-shared-macros)),
write it `\logodds`.
Use it wherever the quantity is the log-odds, including the argument of the logistic function,
so that the same quantity has one symbol in every chapter and figure.
Label a figure axis that shows it "Log-odds, $\logodds$" (see [Axis titles](slides-posters-figures.qmd)).

::: {#exm-log-odds-symbol}

## Argument of the logistic function

> ❌ The logistic [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function) is $\sigma(z) = 1 / (1 + e^{-z})$, evaluated at the log-odds $z$.
>
> ✅ The logistic function is $\sigmoidf{\logodds} \eqdef \frac{1}{1 + \e{-\logodds}}$, evaluated at the log-odds $\logodds$.

The ✅ version uses the lab's symbol for the log-odds, so a reader who has seen $\logodds$ elsewhere recognizes it here.

:::
